# ghost_repository_status_contexts (Data Source)

Lists the commit status check contexts a Ghost repository has seen, such as `ci/build`: the names CI systems report statuses under. These are the checks the web UI suggests for a ruleset's required status checks, so they can feed `ghost_repository_ruleset`'s `rules.required_status_checks.required_check`. Ghost returns only the 50 most recently reported contexts, and listing them needs write access to the repository.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The status check contexts CI has reported on a repository, most recent
# first (at most 50). Listing them needs write access to the repository.
data "ghost_repository_status_contexts" "app" {
  repository = "my-org/my-repo"
}

# Require every CI check the repository has seen, except the deploy previews.
resource "ghost_repository_ruleset" "main" {
  repository  = "my-org/my-repo"
  name        = "protect-main"
  enforcement = "active"

  conditions = {
    ref_name = { include = ["~DEFAULT_BRANCH"] }
  }

  rules = {
    required_status_checks = {
      required_check = [
        for c in sort(data.ghost_repository_status_contexts.app.contexts) : { context = c }
        if startswith(c, "ci/")
      ]
    }
  }
}

output "status_contexts" {
  value = data.ghost_repository_status_contexts.app.contexts
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repository` (String) The repository's full name, `owner/slug`, e.g. `ghost_repository.example.full_name`.

### Read-Only

- `contexts` (List of String) The distinct contexts of the statuses reported on any of the repository's commits, the most recently reported first, at most 50 (older ones drop off). Reporting a status again moves its context to the front. Contexts are case-sensitive, and a status reported without one is listed as `default`. Empty until a status has been reported. A ruleset's required checks don't have to appear here.
- `id` (String) The repository's current full name, `owner/slug`. It differs from `repository` when that names a repository that has since been renamed.
- `repository_id` (Number) The numeric ID of `repository`.
